summary.headline: DAVOLINK: Terasience to sell 2,241,847 shares to MPS Invest for KRW 2.67bn; buyer to change
summary.what_happened: On Nov 25, 2026, Terasience Co., Ltd., the largest shareholder of DAVOLINK Inc., signed an agreement to transfer 2,241,847 shares to MPS Invest Co., Ltd. at KRW 1,190 per share, for a total of KRW 2.67bn. The filing states that the largest shareholder is expected to change to Jeong Yul-geun, with a payment of KRW 235m deposit paid on Dec 23, 2024 and the balance of KRW 2.43bn due on Dec 29, 2026, with the shares to be credited to the buyer's account upon payment. The filing states that management control will not change as a result of this agreement.
summary.why_it_matters: A change of largest shareholder through a share transfer agreement typically signals a shift in the controlling stake, and Korean rules generally require such changes to be disclosed so shareholders can see who will hold the largest stake. Filings of this type often include a correction to the payment or transfer schedule, as this one does.
